figures.caption: Fig. 2. Impedance spectrum for a symme- trical cell Li metal | LPSI electrolyte | com- posite cathode | LPSI electrolyte | Li metal. The spectrum was recorded in the frequency range from 1 MHz to 0.3 mHz. The cross- sectional optical microscopy image shows the composite cathode (II) between the SE layers (I). The average thickness of the composite cathode (II) was (208 ± 5) μm.

figures.caption: Fig. 4. Reconstruction process for a single slice of the composite cathode (all scale bars: 15 μm). (A) Image after restoration process. (B) LCO phase (white) after ﬁn- ished reconstruction. (C) Void space (white) combining the resin-ﬁlled volume and re- sidual void volume. (D) Final image com- bining the three reconstructed phases: blue – LCO particles; red – SE; black – void space. SE was assigned as volume neither occupied by LCO nor void phase. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this ﬁgure le- gend, the reader is referred to the Web version of this article.)

figures.caption: Fig. 6. (A) Phase distribution in an individual slice of the reconstructed cathode. SE is shown in red. Black represents LCO particles and void space, which are both unavailable for diﬀusion of ions. The SE volume fraction is 53.7% (cf. Table 3). (B) Same slice, but voids are now ﬁlled with SE. Therefore, black represents only the LCO particles (cf. Fig. 4B) and the SE volume fraction has increased to 66.9%. Scale bar: 15 μm. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this ﬁgure legend, the reader is referred to the Web version of this article.)

figures.caption: Fig. 7. Simulated transient diﬀusion coeﬃcient D(t) in the reconstructed composite cathode (normalized by the ion diﬀusion coeﬃcient in the bulk SE, Dion,electrolyte) against the dimensionless diﬀusion time tD = 2Dion,electrolytet/ (dLCO)2; dLCO = 5 μm is the mean size of the LCO particles. The black solid line represents results for the actual composition of the three-phase system (LCO, SE, void) in the reconstruction. The red solid line represents results for a ﬁc- titious composition, where all void space has been replaced by SE. Dashed lines indicate the asymptotic (long-time) values of D(t)/Dion,electrolyte, which are used to extract corresponding diﬀusive tortuosities τdiﬀ. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this ﬁgure legend, the reader is referred to the Web version of this article.)

figures.caption: Figure S1. (Top) Generation of chords for the LCO phase (blue vectors) and the combined interparticle phase (green vectors): 26 vectors are projected in angularly equispaced directions from random seed points until they hit an interface (the figure shows exemplarily vectors in the xy-plane). A pair of opposing vectors is combined to one chord. Chords hitting the image border (cf. dashed red line) are rejected. (Bottom) µ- and k-values for LCO, SE, and void phases as well as the combined interparticle phase from CLD analysis, with stepwise increase of the investigated sample volume to address finite-size effects.
